summary.authority: development measurement only; primary stratum is mechanical, no pooled headline
summary.supersedes: PMLAB-ASSOC-E2, retracted for insufficient leakage control
summary.leakage_control: an edge is removed when every group generating it is one of the groups that defined the held-out gold pair; an edge with an independent generating group survives

retrieval_cost_definition.token_definition: whitespace tokens of item text shown at the scored depth; excludes other candidates, metadata and query/prompt wrappers
retrieval_cost_definition.text_fields: project-memory title + summary + body; primary and authored-gold strata remain separate
retrieval_cost_definition.recall_definition: gold-event ID recall; no separate usefulness or critical-evidence weighting unless the runner declares it
retrieval_cost_definition.aggregation: ratio of means: 1000 * sum(per-query recall) / sum(per-query retrieved tokens)
